# artifact-inspect
- purpose: Bounded offline per-file inspection of build directories, ZIP, TAR.GZ, and TGZ with nested ZIP support and safe previews
- version: 0.1.0
- language: Rust
- package: artifact-inspect
- binary: artifact-inspect
- build: cd artifact-inspect && cargo build --release
- input: directory, ZIP, TAR.GZ, TGZ; symlink input rejected
- nested_input: any regular file with .zip name or ZIP signature; bounded memory; default max depth 4; corrupt nested ZIP emits nested_zip_invalid
- archive_integrity: regular ZIP members are streamed to EOF for size/decompression/CRC validation; TAR.GZ decoder is drained through the gzip trailer; corrupt outer input exits 3 without JSON/HTML success reports
- output: artifact-inspect.json, artifact-inspect.html, artifact-inspect.log under required --output-dir
- output_guard: output must be outside a directory input; JSON/HTML/log symlinks, hard links, non-regular targets, and input-file aliases are rejected with exit 2; ordinary files are atomically replaced without following links
- network: none
- execution: never executes archived/build content
- extraction: no archive extraction to disk; no input writes
- report_schema_version: 1

## Command Syntax
```
artifact-inspect <INPUT> --output-dir <DIR> [LIMITS] [--json]
artifact-inspect __schema
```

## Limits
- --max-entries: 100000
- --max-total-raw-bytes: 2000000000
- --max-nested-bytes: 67108864
- --max-depth: 4
- --max-preview-bytes: 65536
- --max-total-preview-bytes: 8388608
- --max-image-pixels: 16777216

## Report Fields
- container: id, logical path, kind, depth, parent, files, issues, summary
- file: container_id, container, relative_path, kind, raw_bytes, zip_compressed_bytes, preview
- summary: file_count, raw_bytes, zip_compressed_bytes, preview_count, suppressed_preview_count
- zip_compressed_bytes: ZIP entry compressed payload size; null for directory and TAR.GZ members
- accounting: each container independent; no cross-layer byte total
- transfer: ZIP entry compressed bytes exclude archive overhead and are not network transfer bytes
- engine_formats: Godot/Unity classified but not parsed; no asset provenance claim

## Preview Safety
- bitmap: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP; dimension and decode validation; pixel and byte limits; inert data URI
- text: bounded UTF-8; HTML escaped
- active_content: HTML/JavaScript/SVG shown as escaped text only
- sensitive: private/secret/credential/token paths, any *.env, .env.*, .envrc, keys and keystores have suppressed_sensitive preview with no content; sensitive nested containers inherit suppression while keeping paths/sizes
- html: standalone offline; CSP default-src none; no script or external resources
- links: input/archive symlinks and TAR hard links not followed

## Machine Call Contract (r_lit CLI contract v1)
- spec: docs/cli-contract.md (repository root)
- json: --json prints exactly one envelope; logs go to stderr
- envelope: {contract:1, ok, tool, version, command:"", data, artifacts, error, warnings?}
- data: report paths, input, issue_count, per-container summaries, size semantics, engine-format limitation
- artifacts: inventory-json, inventory-html, log with path/bytes/sha256
- schema: artifact-inspect __schema
- effects: pure; declared output directory only
- exit_codes: 0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 3 input, 4 external reserved, 5 partial reserved

## Tests
```
cd artifact-inspect && cargo test
cd artifact-inspect && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
C4_INPUT=/path/c4-zuma-wechat-qa.tar.gz C4_REFERENCE=/path/C4-文件清单.json cargo test --test c4_reference -- --ignored --nocapture
```
- c4_reference: exact 164-row path/raw-byte/ZIP-compressed-byte comparison; verifies 25/7696698 outer and 139/2093130/1979382 nested baselines; out/project.private.config.json and env/runtime.env both suppressed with no text/media/image content
- release: local-only delivery; no Jenkins/cross-platform artifact claimed
